title: Restriction formula represents the restricted term
statement: Let $T$ be a DNF term on $n$ coordinates, and let each coordinate be free, fixed to $1$, or fixed to $-1$. The Boolean function represented by the restriction formula of $T$ agrees on every sign vector with the function obtained by evaluating $T$ after completing the restriction using that vector on the free coordinates.
